phase_prompt.label: System Guide
phase_prompt.summary: The angel appears as a solemn administrator of the simulation, guiding the viewer through the backend of reality.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A medium shot of the Guiding Angel, a construct of black obsidian and fiber-optics, gesturing towards a rift in the simulation sky. His robes of liquid glass flow with a slow, calculated physics. His face is unreadable, a sleek visor of dark material reflecting the chaotic data of the world. The background is a flat-earth horizon grid overlaid with atmospheric plasma. The lighting is cool and clinical, with a sharp rim light highlighting the edges of his synthetic form. Hyper-realistic, cinematic composition, emotional weight.
